# three-fiber-component-shape-planner

Purpose: Plan the React Three Fiber component shape (props, refs, Suspense, useGLTF cache, animation hooks) before delivering a GLB to a web team.

Translate a planned GLB delivery into the exact public surface a React Three Fiber component should expose, so the web engineer's contract is locked before code is written.

Metadata: Category `evidence-and-handoff` | Role `r3f-component-contract-architect` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- the GLB will ship to a web app using React Three Fiber
- before the web team writes the component
- when "I'll just import the GLB" needs more rigor (multiple clips, prop overrides, lazy loading)
- Trigger phrases: "how should the React component look", "what props should I expose", "ref shape for the model", "we use react-three-fiber"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- consumers using vanilla Three.js (different API) → use `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-glb-web-handoff.md`; different API)
- consumers using Babylon / model-viewer (different stack) → use `glb-animation-handoff` (`references/skill-glb-animation-handoff.md`; different stack)
- the GLB is rendered server-side (e.g. AR pre-render); no React component needed → use `non-blender-user-response-writer` (`references/skill-non-blender-user-response-writer.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to non-blender-user-response-writer)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `glb_delivery_contract` (`object`): Locked GLB node hierarchy, material slots, and compression spec from glb-web-handoff
- Required input `r3f_version_and_use_case` (`object`): Target @react-three/fiber major version (8 vs 9) and interactive component use case
- Optional input `animation_clip_contract` (`object`): Optional clip names, triggers, and crossfade rules from glb-animation-handoff
- Output contract: `r3f_component_props_and_ref_spec`, `suspense_caching_and_dispose_contract`, `consumer_call_site_usage_outline` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. enumerate the props the consumer needs (color, animation name, scale, onLoaded)
2. decide ref shape (forwardRef, imperative methods)
3. decide Suspense boundary location
4. decide useGLTF caching + cleanup strategy
5. decide animation hook contract (auto-play, manual control)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: This skill produces **planning specs only**. It does not generate component code, run a web app, or claim that the resulting component will perform correctly without measured load tests. Web-side implementation is owned by the consumer team.
- Generate React or Three.js component implementation code.
- Run web apps or execute React Three Fiber at runtime.
- Claim or verify web runtime performance.
- Upgrade truth states (web runtime belongs to the consumer team, not BlendOps).
- Own animation contracts, performance budgets, color/material validation, or web delivery packaging.
